steps.note: The cheese is set by the eggs in a baked cheesecake, and by cream in an unbaked one.
The mixture is filled onto a crushed-biscuit or pastry base, or onto no base at all.
The cheesecake is chilled, since it is usually served cold.

sources.text: The ingredients, bases and baked or unbaked styles of cheesecake from soft fresh cheese; the article gives no baking temperature or time.
